subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw accept an Agentic OS-specific lease-bound session API in core, or require an owner-neutral core seam with the Agentic OS contract implemented by its owning integration?
rationale: The answer determines the permanent public Gateway and persistence boundary; it cannot safely be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Require an owner-neutral seam
options.body: Keep generic lease-authorized spawning in core only if needed, and move Agentic OS field names, lifecycle policy, and discovery contract to the owning integration.

options.title: Accept the core contract
options.body: Treat these Agentic OS RPC names and metadata fields as a supported core Gateway API, with explicit compatibility, migration, and ownership commitments.

recommendation.title: Require an owner-neutral seam
recommendation.body: Keep generic lease-authorized spawning in core only if needed, and move Agentic OS field names, lifecycle policy, and discovery contract to the owning integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership evidence was unavailable in the supplied review context, but the decision belongs with the core Gateway/session product owner.
